observations.content: User provided a 12-turn context-only preparation packet for a later implementation task; turns 1–8 are present here, with multiple explicit requests to acknowledge each packet as CONTEXT_RECEIVED and not implement yet.

Historical implementation requirements: workers must run from the owning session's `<resolved-memory-root>` working directory after memory becomes session-scoped; use the runtime-resolved root, create it even for fresh sessions without durable files, and preserve model, prompt, environment, result handoff, cancellation, and exit handling.

Project is an observational-memory pi extension with Phase A short-term observer/ledger/compaction and Phase B consolidator/topic files; worker sessions are ordinary recorded headless pi subprocess sessions, not the subagents extension.

The implementation plan specifies a per-session `/om` gate defaulting OFF, persisted via `om.enabled`, parallel observer chunks committed to a branch-local ledger, deterministic compaction, per-session `.memory/<sessionId>/` long-term memory, and worker result/cost IPC.

Addendum requires `.memory/INDEX.md`, topic files, JOURNEY.md and `.runs/` under `.memory/<immutable-session-header-id>/`; forked sessions seed from parent once, excluding `.runs/`, while resume/tree do not reseed.

Repository excerpts identify master orchestrator at `src/index.ts`, shared worker extension at `agent/index.ts`, per-session root handling at `src/memory/session.ts`, and worker launch/environment construction at `src/spawn/launch.ts`.

Current repository configuration defaults in `src/config.ts` differ from plan defaults: chunkTokens 10,000, consolidateAtPoolTokens 15,000, and observer/consolidator models `openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.2` with low/medium thinking.

Current `src/spawn/launch.ts` sets worker cwd to the master cwd in `spawnWorker`; `buildWorkerEnv` passes `OM_MEMORY_DIR`, result path, cost path, role, and run id. This is pertinent to the later working-directory requirement.

Consolidator system prompt in `agent/consolidator/prompt.ts` currently describes tools and content as scoped to `.memory/`, while tools in `agent/consolidator/tools.ts` resolve paths against explicit `OM_MEMORY_DIR`.

`src/hooks/consolidator-trigger.ts` and `src/hooks/observer-trigger.ts` both build worker args/env and call `spawnWorker` with `cwd: ctx.cwd`; they also preserve cost recording and respective consolidator tombstoning or observer ledger commit behavior.

The packet includes tests for compaction cutoffs/observer wait fast path, consolidator sandbox tools and worker environment, cost tracking, timestamp IDs, and ledger folding; these represent existing behavior that a later implementation should preserve.
